# Documentation Index

This is the only index of the design documents under `.github/docs/`, which are written for contributors. User documentation (usage, migration, capacity tables) is in [docs/](../../docs/).

[docs_authoring_guidelines.md](docs_authoring_guidelines.md) gives the authoring rules, document types and naming conventions.

## Design principles

| Document | Covers |
|---|---|
| [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md) | Library design principles (English + Japanese) |

## Specs (`specs/`)

This folder holds design records and spec-to-code maps for shipped behavior, organized symbology-first.

| Document | Type | Covers |
|---|---|---|
| [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) | Architecture record | Symbology model, shared vs per-symbology components, API and data-model direction, scope decisions |
| [qrcode-simd-tiers.md](specs/qrcode-simd-tiers.md) | Generated tables | The SIMD tier each kernel runs on each build: the builds in each build class, what each class leaves to the CPU, the tier key, every kernel's tiers and cells. A test renders the tables from `SimdTiers.cs` |
| [standardqr-spec-map.md](specs/standardqr-spec-map.md) | Spec-to-code map | Standard QR pipeline vs ISO/IEC 18004 |
| [standardqr-encoder.md](specs/standardqr-encoder.md) | Design record | Standard QR encoder scope and decisions (single segment per input, Kanji on request for text that JIS X 0208 holds, ECI policy) |
| [standardqr-decoder.md](specs/standardqr-decoder.md) | Design record | Standard QR decoder scope, input tiers, lessons learned |
| [qrcode-test-fixtures.md](specs/qrcode-test-fixtures.md) | Design record | Committed fixture corpus, manifest schema, external-oracle capability matrix, image decode sweep and real-image corpus measured against other readers |
| [qrcode-cross-language-benchmark.md](specs/qrcode-cross-language-benchmark.md) | Design record | Speed against readers and writers outside .NET (zxing-cpp, libzint, quirc, zbar, libqrencode, the Rust crates, the JVM readers, Go): one protocol and collector for every language's CLI, whole-process timing as an outside check, one Docker image for linux-x64 and linux-arm64, the CI workflow, a results summary and lessons on measuring |
| [qrcode-gs1-data.md](specs/qrcode-gs1-data.md) | Design record | The `FeatherQR.Gs1` package: GS1's QR carriers, the AI table generated from the GS1 Barcode Syntax Dictionary and how a new release is noticed and shipped, the checks, `(AI)` text and Digital Link URIs in both directions, the read after a decode, the generator entry points, costs, scope, decisions and lessons |
| [microqr-spec-map.md](specs/microqr-spec-map.md) | Spec-to-code map | Micro QR encoding and decoding pipelines vs ISO/IEC 18004 |
| [microqr-decoder.md](specs/microqr-decoder.md) | Design record | Micro QR decoder scope (matrix and image level), single-finder image path, decode figures, decisions, lessons learned |
| [rmqr-spec-map.md](specs/rmqr-spec-map.md) | Spec-to-code map | rMQR pipeline vs ISO/IEC 23941 (encoder, rendering, matrix decoder and image detection implemented) |
| [rmqr-encoder.md](specs/rmqr-encoder.md) | Design record | rMQR encoder API, oracle-verified symbol parameter tables, decisions, verification record (spec-first) |
| [rmqr-decoder.md](specs/rmqr-decoder.md) | Design record | rMQR decoder scope (matrix and image level), image detection design (format-first, sub-finder anchored, gated perspective search), decisions including the open Table 8 misdecode-protection reading, lessons |

## Plans (`plans/`)

Plans hold forward-looking strategy. After implementation, durable decisions move into `specs/` and the plan is deleted, not kept as a parallel history.

| Document | Covers |
|---|---|
| [featherqr-2.0.0-plan.md](plans/featherqr-2.0.0-plan.md) | Remaining 2.0.0 work: naming rule and renames, announced removals, value-kind and immutability unification, symbol geometry, Structured Append, Kanji encoding, 128-bit tiers for builds without AVX2, GS1 / FNC1, release checklist |

The 2.0.0 core split plan (`FeatherQR` core, `FeatherQR.SkiaSharp` renderer, `SkiaSharp.QrCode` metapackage, repository rename) completed on 2026-09-06 and was folded into [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) (package architecture, seam, graph, the "why three packages" record, scope decisions, lessons) and [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md).

The Micro QR / rMQR implementation and test-strategy plans, the Kanji mode decode plan and the generator API options plan completed and were folded into the specs above. [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) has their API and options rules, Kanji mapping decision and scope table. [qrcode-test-fixtures.md](specs/qrcode-test-fixtures.md) has the oracle landscape, test-layer reasoning and fixture lessons. The per-symbology encoder and decoder records have the rest.

The Standard QR matrix decode plan (codeword extraction through the encoder's placement runs, the 64-bit window bit stream reader, ARM64 measurement, the re-associated AdvSimd syndrome kernel) completed on 2026-09-21 and was folded into [standardqr-decoder.md](specs/standardqr-decoder.md) (decisions, measurements, why the round stopped where it did, lessons on measuring and verifying a hot-path change) and [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) (the reopened and re-closed ARM64 queue).

The encode performance plan (Standard QR mask selection, measured as most of an encode, and the costs around it: an indexed ECC table, shared finder-window terms, a transposed scorer for versions 12 to 40 on AVX2, 128-bit and ARM64 builds, the pinned mask applied from packed templates, the Alphanumeric and Numeric writers, the class pack and the quiet-zone window of the three span outputs, Reed-Solomon blocks side by side, placement into the transposed scorer, and the scalar scorer .NET Framework runs) completed on 2026-10-08. It was folded into [standardqr-encoder.md](specs/standardqr-encoder.md) (the pipeline steps, the decisions on mask selection and unsafe code, the stage profile, the performance lessons, the output-stability check) and [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) (`QuietZoneWindow`, `ModuleBitPacker` and the shared Reed-Solomon entry, the lessons on measuring an encode change, and the builds not timed and the leads left open in the scope table), with the spec maps, [rmqr-encoder.md](specs/rmqr-encoder.md) and `SimdTiers.cs` updated as each change landed. The writer plan had run inside it and was folded into [standardqr-encoder.md](specs/standardqr-encoder.md) on 2026-10-05. The README's benchmark images were taken again from one run of the encode and decode classes. It left out per-round narration, test and fault counts, and timing tables.

The Standard QR image decode plan (the threshold fill's vector tiers and mirrored second polarity, the vectorized piecewise mesh sampler, the finder search's cross-check walks, run bounds and edge-list row kernel, ARM64 measurement and tiers) completed on 2026-09-23 and was folded into [standardqr-decoder.md](specs/standardqr-decoder.md) (the decision on what stayed bit-identical and where the round stopped, per-stage measurements on both machines, lessons on measuring) and [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) (the shared binarizer, the ARM64 queue reopened for three stages).

The decode pipeline diagrams plan completed on 2026-09-27 and was folded into the three spec-to-code maps (matrix and image diagrams matching the decoders, a maintenance rule), the three decoder records (decode figures, with [microqr-decoder.md](specs/microqr-decoder.md) created for them, and three stages found almost never to decide inside the measured envelope), [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) (the shared image decode passes), the [authoring guidelines](docs_authoring_guidelines.md) (diagram and figure rules), the test-first skill and `tools/decode_figures.cs`. It left out encoder diagrams and figures (not audited), plan identifiers and other-library names already in the specs (separate cleanups), rewrites of correct but long design-record prose, and figures captured from a decoder run (a trace needs hooks into internals, and the figures explain the same path without them).

The SIMD tier coverage plan (which tier each kernel runs on which build, stated in one table and checked against the builds, plus the tier file layout) completed on 2026-09-28 and was folded into [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) (the SIMD tier inventory with the four build classes and what keeps the table true, two scope decisions, lessons on dispatch codegen, NativeAOT, ARM64 knobs, moving code between files and WebAssembly). The table's only copy is `src/FeatherQR/Internals/SimdTiers.cs`. Since 2026-10-02 [qrcode-simd-tiers.md](specs/qrcode-simd-tiers.md) shows it rendered. It left out the decisions the table is for: which instruction set a NativeAOT publish should target, and 128-bit tiers where x64 without AVX runs scalar.

The image decode accuracy plan (renders and photographs another reader decodes and this library does not, counted on the same images: 2,002 synthetic Standard QR renders and 153 real-image reads on 2026-09-21, 18 and 28 on 2026-09-28) completed on 2026-09-28 and was folded into [qrcode-test-fixtures.md](specs/qrcode-test-fixtures.md) (the sweep tool, its measuring rules, where the gap stands, the cause of each remaining real image, oracle lessons), the three decoder records (envelopes against the other readers, plus decisions, refuted candidates, leads and lessons of regional binarization, the Micro QR and rMQR failure paths, Micro QR grid evidence, the grey-level frame, the finders' frame and the stages before it, the like-edge finder check, the small-lattice mesh and rMQR's perimeter trace, with [standardqr-decoder.md](specs/standardqr-decoder.md) also holding lessons on measuring an accuracy change), [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) (the passes' skip and verdict rules) and the Micro QR and rMQR spec maps. It left out per-round narration and test counts, benchmark tables that decided nothing, and one machine's shell-tool traps.

The Structured Append plan (decode, the balanced encode split, interop, fourteen performance rounds, the adversarial review of the branch) completed on 2026-09-29 and was folded into [standardqr-encoder.md](specs/standardqr-encoder.md) (design, refusal rule, decisions, lessons), [standardqr-decoder.md](specs/standardqr-decoder.md) (decode decisions, reassembly rules, a lesson on one-conditional rules) and [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) (the decode result member only Standard QR has). The corpus and interop checks were already in [qrcode-test-fixtures.md](specs/qrcode-test-fixtures.md), and the plan's open items became follow-ups F20 to F23 of the 2.0.0 plan. It left out per-round narration, test counts and benchmark tables.

The decode pipeline structure plan (the decoders held against the generators' pipeline shape: allocation guards over every decode path, shared image decode passes, result rule and image view, one module buffer per scan, a shared Reed-Solomon block stage, rMQR's format positions stated once, the four-point sampler moved to the shared namespace, a failed matrix decode reporting no characters written) completed on 2026-09-30 and was folded into [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) (shared decode primitives, the result rules and why Standard QR keeps its own, the allocation contract with its guard and measuring lessons, lessons on timing a refactor), [qrcode-test-fixtures.md](specs/qrcode-test-fixtures.md) (a baseline built apart, the corpus compared on this library's columns), [standardqr-decoder.md](specs/standardqr-decoder.md) (the failure diagnostics decision, the module buffer lesson and its cost), [rmqr-decoder.md](specs/rmqr-decoder.md) (two lessons on the format readers) and [migration.md](../../docs/migration.md) (characters written on a failed matrix decode). Its open decision on decoder options became D8 of the 2.0.0 plan, decided against on 2026-10-02. It left out the findings table of the review it started from, per-phase narration and test counts, and each phase's timing tables.

The 128-bit tiers plan (a portable 128-bit tier for each kernel that ran scalar on x64 without AVX or on WebAssembly, where one beat that build's code when measured on that build, plus the timing mode of the report projects, the merge of main's shared image decode and its follow-ups, and the ARM64 measurement) completed on 2026-10-01 and was folded into [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) (the round's rules, measuring method, end-to-end result and lessons under the SIMD tier inventory, plus the scope row and shared kernels with no record of their own), the four encoder and decoder records of Standard QR and rMQR (each kernel's tier, numbers and lessons) and the reasons beside the rows of `SimdTiers.cs`. It left out per-phase narration, the variant and kernel tables, and each change's instruction counts.

The shared candidate scan plan (Micro QR's and rMQR's per-candidate rules checked by one contract test both decoders run, their candidate scan and grid read moved into shared code, a short-destination measurement in the sweep tool) completed on 2026-10-01 and was folded into [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) (the single-finder candidate scan: its rules and their reasons, what they cost before, how they are checked and their residuals, plus the lesson on the order of an A/B run), [qrcode-test-fixtures.md](specs/qrcode-test-fixtures.md) (the `destination` measurement, plus lessons on premises, masked faults, worst cases and the mutation tool) and the Micro QR and rMQR decoder records and spec maps, which keep only their own parts and link the shared code. It left out per-phase narration and benchmark tables. The planted faults, including those a review added, are in [tools/mutants/single-finder-candidate-scan.tsv](../../tools/mutants/single-finder-candidate-scan.tsv).

The Kanji encoding plan (Kanji mode written by all three generators on request through `AllowKanji`, the reverse table, an eighth segmentation state, Kanji Structured Append sets, the interop sweep and the phone scans that turned the default back to UTF-8, and the speed work) completed on 2026-10-02 and was folded into:
- [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md): which texts are written in Kanji mode and why the rule is not wider (on request only, no Kanji beside an ECI header, the seven CP932-divergent cells), the reverse table, trimmed sizes, the scope row and lessons.
- [standardqr-encoder.md](specs/standardqr-encoder.md): the Kanji plan under `Optimal`, Kanji Structured Append sets and their parity, the scalar lanes, the speed record and lessons.
- [rmqr-encoder.md](specs/rmqr-encoder.md): the Kanji scan's filters, and why its build runs the program itself.
- [qrcode-test-fixtures.md](specs/qrcode-test-fixtures.md): the Kanji fixtures, the oracle test, `spot-check-kanji` and oracle lessons.
- `docs/migration.md`, the README, and the Kanji columns of `docs/data-capacity.md`.

It left out per-phase narration, step timings and benchmark tables, and the code inventory the plan was written from.

The cross-language benchmark plan (a protocol, collector and outside check, then FeatherQR on the JIT and NativeAOT, zxing-cpp, libzint, the ZXingCpp package, rqrr, fast_qr, BoofCV, ZXing, quirc, zbar, libqrencode, the qrcode crate, gozxing and go-qrcode, and a CI workflow on linux-x64 and linux-arm64) completed on 2026-10-06 and was folded into:
- [qrcode-cross-language-benchmark.md](specs/qrcode-cross-language-benchmark.md): what the harness measures and how its numbers are checked, why each library is there and how it is called, the decisions, a results summary from one CI run of every library on both architectures with the findings across runs, how well each machine measures, and lessons on measuring, runtimes, wrappers and machines.
- [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md): NativeAOT's instruction-set target under the SIMD tier inventory (the probe, the gap split into lost tiers and ahead-of-time code, the kernels behind it, what the library can and cannot change) and the scope row, which keeps the README and user guidance on `IlcInstructionSet` open.
- [microqr-decoder.md](specs/microqr-decoder.md) and [standardqr-encoder.md](specs/standardqr-encoder.md), which already held the codeword extraction and the double analysis the benchmark found.

It left out per-phase narration and per-entry tables, the first rough NativeAOT timing that the measured gap replaced, and each library's absolute times outside the summary run. A CI run's results stay in its artifacts for as long as GitHub keeps them.

The generator options settable plan (the three generator options moved from `init` to `set` accessors before the 2.0.0 freeze, their constructors for compilers before C# 9 removed, and IDE0251 made a build error on the two shipping projects) completed on 2026-10-10 and was folded into [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) (why the options are settable and the option objects a builder holds are not, why a constructor that lists the options cannot take a new one, how reads through `in` stay free of copies, why `init` and `set` cannot be exchanged inside a major version, two scope rows, lessons) and [migration.md](../../docs/migration.md) (older language versions, the options as plain values). The planted faults are in [tools/mutants/generator-options-settable.tsv](../../tools/mutants/generator-options-settable.tsv). It left out per-phase narration, test and fault counts, the measurements' tables and the probes they came from.

The photograph decode plan (where the image decoders stand against zxing-cpp and go-qr on photograph sets and photograph-like renders, a charset guess for Byte segments with no ECI header, ten image stages for Standard QR from a search at reduced scale to the finder cross-checks, the halving's vector tiers, and the README, specs and XML docs rewritten from the measurements) completed on 2026-10-12. BoofCV's photographs went from 322 of 536 to 456, against zxing-cpp's 392 and go-qr's 412, ZXing's from 151 of 179 upright to 170, and the committed corpus from 425 of 548 to 493. It was folded into:

- [standardqr-decoder.md](specs/standardqr-decoder.md): a decision row a stage, with its measurements, its cost and what would reopen it; the charset rule; the mesh and performance lessons; the measurements on ARM64; lessons on measuring an accuracy change and a hot path.
- [qrcode-test-fixtures.md](specs/qrcode-test-fixtures.md): the photograph sets and camera kinds, how each set and reader is obtained and run, the tables against both readers, the cause of every photograph left, the measuring rules and lessons.
- [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md): the shared finder scan, the scope rows for several symbols in one image, the builds not timed and the leads left open.
- [microqr-decoder.md](specs/microqr-decoder.md) and [rmqr-decoder.md](specs/rmqr-decoder.md): what of it reaches them.

It left out per-stage narration, test and planted-fault counts, timing tables that decided nothing, and one machine's shell and toolchain traps. Open at the fold was whether the two costs the stages put on symbols that already read (the version read at the finders, the row beside a centre row) are taken back. Both were on 2026-10-13, each by a condition the decoder's Decisions record.

The GS1 plan (the `FeatherQR.Gs1` package: an AI table generated from the GS1 Barcode Syntax Dictionary, the checks, `(AI)` text and Digital Link URIs, the read after a decode, the generator entry points, the rules between elements made linear, the Playground's data format, the dictionary update procedure and the monthly workflow) completed on 2026-10-16 and was folded into:

- [qrcode-gs1-data.md](specs/qrcode-gs1-data.md), created for it: GS1's carriers from the General Specifications, the data layer and the entry points, the dictionary's cadence and how a release is noticed, what is out of scope with its revisit conditions, the costs, why the layer is built as it is, the decisions and the lessons.
- [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md): the fourth package, the license that made it one, its extension members and the scope row, with a short GS1 data section that links the record.
- [qrcode-test-fixtures.md](specs/qrcode-test-fixtures.md), which already held the GS1 oracles, the corpus and their disagreements.
- The header of `tools/get_gs1_syntax_engine.cs` (the update steps), the README's GS1 section and the [authoring guidelines](docs_authoring_guidelines.md) (the record's exception to the one home of shared content).

It left out per-phase and per-review narration, test and planted-fault counts, the approved API listing, which each `PublicAPI.approved.txt` holds, the benchmark tables, and the research's survey of other .NET packages and of the symbol specification tables.

The FNC1 plan (both FNC1 modes read and written in Standard QR and rMQR: the rMQR indicators the records had called reserved, the `%` rule and the separator pairs no Alphanumeric segment can carry, the `Fnc1Mode` shape, the oracle fixtures, the interop sweep and the Playground's selector) completed on 2026-10-16 and was folded into:

- [standardqr-decoder.md](specs/standardqr-decoder.md) and [rmqr-decoder.md](specs/rmqr-decoder.md): the `Fnc1Mode` shape and why, the `%` reading, the placement rule, the rMQR indicator rows with their sources, and lessons on standards and test vectors.
- [standardqr-encoder.md](specs/standardqr-encoder.md) and [rmqr-encoder.md](specs/rmqr-encoder.md): the header order, FNC1 beside ECI and Structured Append, the separator pairs under `Single` and `Optimal`, the route without FNC1, and lessons on the fork and its fallback.
- The two spec maps (the editions of the standards read) and [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md) (a lesson on benchmark jobs). [qrcode-test-fixtures.md](specs/qrcode-test-fixtures.md), `docs/migration.md`, `docs/data-capacity.md` and the README already had their FNC1 parts.

It left out per-phase and per-review narration, test counts, the probe tables, the code inventory and the equivalence classes, which the tests hold. ISO/IEC 23941's mode table is still unread, so rMQR's `101` and `110` rest on the implementations' mode tables and writers.

The image decode follow-ups plan (the photograph stages timed on WebAssembly, then several symbols in one image for Standard QR: the ceiling measured by painting each read symbol over and reading again, an internal entry that reaches it in one call, the regional binarization and the histogram made faster, the row scan's edges, the measurements on an Apple M2, the maintainer's rulings, the public calls and the Playground's option to read every QR Code) completed on 2026-10-26. BoofCV's 1,232 codes went from 456 read, one a photograph, to 1,073 in one call, against zxing-cpp's 977, at 2.2 times the one-symbol call over the set, and the one-symbol call itself fell to 0.67 of its time on x64. It was folded into:

- [standardqr-decoder.md](specs/standardqr-decoder.md): the Decisions row "Several symbols of one image", with the contract, what each rule of the entry buys and costs and the counts behind the ruling; the lessons on what the one-symbol search leaves alone, on the sheets of 60 codes and the leads they left; and the Performance lessons on the regional binarization, the histogram's lanes and their floor, the row scan's edges, the WebAssembly ratios and the measurements on ARM64.
- [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md): the scope rows "Several symbols in one image", "Image detection default" (the Playground's option and what its preview taught), "Image decode changes of 2026-10 on builds not timed" and "Image decode leads left open", the `Binarizer` and `LocalBinarizer` entries, and the lesson on the interpreter's two speeds.
- [qrcode-test-fixtures.md](specs/qrcode-test-fixtures.md): the `boofcv` command's codes column and the rules that score it, the read-again and entry tables, and the result lines that carry each read's centre.
- [standardqr-spec-map.md](specs/standardqr-spec-map.md) ("Image level, every symbol"), [qrcode-simd-tiers.md](specs/qrcode-simd-tiers.md) (the kernel table), and the README and `docs/`, which the async API plan's Phase 4 wrote.

It left out per-phase narration, test and planted-fault counts, timing tables that decided nothing, the forms of the edge extraction that were refused, and the commits each measurement was taken at. Micro QR and rMQR, out of it by the ruling of 2026-10-15, got the same calls from the plan folded below, and the read of the three in one call from the plan folded after it.

The async API plan (where generation and reading block a caller's thread, measured by setting; the fourteen async writes; the stream reads with their result types, limits and synchronous twins; cancellation between the symbols of a read for every symbol; the move off a UI context with copies of what the call was given; four review rounds and the safe default limits) completed on 2026-10-26 and was folded into:

- [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md): under Public API direction, the reads' naming rule, the async I/O rules, the pairing of every synchronous and asynchronous form and what the async forms cost; under Why, why the async API stops at the I/O, with the measured costs, the settings, the pipe shape without the pipe types and the reasons behind each ruling; the scope rows "Async API" and "Stream read limits"; the package seam's result-type constructors; the stream reads outside the allocation contract; and the lessons on Skia's codecs, encoders and SVG text, on copying a builder, on the pool's rounding and on measuring allocations.
- [standardqr-decoder.md](specs/standardqr-decoder.md): the token checked between symbols and how long a read runs past a cancel, in the Decisions row "Several symbols of one image".
- The README (Async and stream I/O, the FAQ), `docs/migration.md` (the move from `SKBitmap.Decode(stream)`, the limits) and the API page, which the plan's Phase 4 wrote and the review rounds corrected.

It left out the caller examples, which the README and the migration guide hold, the settings tables beyond their conclusion, per-round review narration, test and planted-fault counts, and the benchmark tables beyond their ratios.

The Micro QR and rMQR several-symbols plan (the ceiling and the price measured on composed sheets with no change to `src`, an internal entry for each through one scan written beside the one-symbol scan, where the time goes, the maintainer's rulings, then the public calls in Standard QR's shape, the Playground's fallback from one symbology to the next and the docs) completed on 2026-10-27. On 84 sheets a symbology of 2 to 100 symbols the call reads 2,347 of 2,436 Micro QR codes and 2,435 of 2,436 rMQR codes with no false read, and on an image of one symbol it returns the one-symbol read and nothing else, at 1.27 and 3.80 times that call, within 2 and 7 % of what a call that goes on after a read through the same passes pays. A photograph full of Standard QR finders costs far more, since each finder is searched in full. It was folded into:

- [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md): "Every symbol of an image" under the single-finder candidate scan, with its rules against the one-symbol scan's, the listings check, the counts, the costs, where the time goes and the rules refused. Also the scope rows "Several symbols in one image" and "Image detection default", the pairing of the synchronous and asynchronous reads, and the token rules.
- [microqr-decoder.md](specs/microqr-decoder.md) and [rmqr-decoder.md](specs/rmqr-decoder.md): the image level paragraph and the Decisions row "Every symbol of an image", with what would reopen it.
- [qrcode-test-fixtures.md](specs/qrcode-test-fixtures.md): the `sheets` and `again` commands, and the lessons on the floor of a call that goes on, on room tests, on a rule another holds, on checking a rule on the whole set, on a report checked against its sentence and on a candidate found again.
- The two spec maps ("Image level, every symbol"), the README, `docs/migration.md`, the approved API listings and the API page.

It left out per-phase narration, the per-sheet and per-kind tables, the Micro QR camera sheets' code-by-code difference, and the probe the listings were compared on. The planted faults are in [tools/mutants/single-finder-several-symbols.tsv](../../tools/mutants/single-finder-several-symbols.tsv).

The mixed symbology read plan (one call for every symbol of an image whatever its symbology: the price and the ceiling measured first with no change to `src`, an internal entry, the maintainer's rulings on the result type, the entry's home, the order, where the single-finder decoders run, the Playground and the release, the price cut by sharing the histogram, then the public call, the Playground's checkbox and the docs) completed on 2026-10-29. On 432 sheets of two and three symbologies it reads 2,884 of 3,024 codes with no false read, 16 more than the three every-symbol calls in turn, and on BoofCV's photographs the Standard QR entry's 1,073 codes and nothing else, at 2.7 times that entry. It was folded into:

- [qrcode-symbologies.md](specs/qrcode-symbologies.md): "Every symbol of any symbology" after the single-finder scan's every-symbol section, with the rules, the code paths, the listings check, the counts, the price, where the time goes, the shapes measured and not taken, and what is left. Also the internal organization, the package seam, the result type and the classes under Public API direction, and the scope rows "Image detection default" and "Several symbols in one image".
